scope: sales_fact.parquet, all years present in the file
rule_audited: GPS lubricant exclusion keyed on part-number prefix 55004*/55007*

pms_catalogue_contamination.note: 0 means these fluids sit in the GPS parts base only and do not inflate PMS capture actuals.

caveats: Description-based detection. A fluid with no fluid marker in its description is not caught; a hardware part named like a fluid is.
Sizes an exclusion gap only. No GPS percentage is computed or restated here.
